purpose: Assemble v13's deliverable frontier from sealed evidence only. Nothing here is recomputed; every cell cites the milestone and evidence hash it was read from.
registration_notes: N85.5 - absent cells stay absent. Where a milestone did not produce a figure the cell reads 'absent' with a reason, and is never filled from the nearest available number, a different task width, or a different corpus.

N85.11 - every arm M81 measured is listed, and no arm is selected for the table. A frontier assembled by picking one point per family is the cherry-picking R4 was written against; the reader is given the whole measured set and the selection rules are left in M81's gate where they are auditable.
R4 - both I5 widths or neither. Each arm appears at I5-128 and at I5-8 with its own chance level and its own shuffled null, and no figure from one width is reported without the other.
R5 - each I5 figure is printed beside the shuffled-explanation null sharing its structure, budget and split.
R7 - the v12 CIFAR-10 figures are retained in a separate block, labelled as v12 CIFAR-10 at 8-way I5, and may not be compared against any v13 number. They are history, not bars.

N85.12 - the open-set column is a property of the boundary, not of any head. Every head in this table reads the same frozen features and the same fitted geometry, so a per-head OOD column would imply a distinction that was never measured. It is reported once, for the boundary, with both its threshold operand and its threshold-free one.

m81_sparse_head.provides: accuracy, I5 at both widths, shuffled-explanation nulls, active parameter counts

m84_exposure_ladder.provides: open-set rejection recall at matched known coverage

m85_open_set_auroc.provides: the threshold-free open-set operand and its free baselines

m85_transfer_eval.provides: dictionary retention on the transfer corpus and its resolution control

v12_history.note: Amendment R7. v12 CIFAR-10 figures at 8-way I5, retained as historical reference only. Not v13 bars. The v13 corpus is 128-class DomainNet and its raw-probe accuracy bar is 61.304 percent, so no cell below is comparable to any cell above it.
